projects.title: b2d_geo
projects.subtitle: Public-data infrastructure for AI agents
projects.description: A production-deployed Korean geospatial platform that turns public address, parcel, zoning, and land-price data into structured evidence for applications and AI agents.
projects.longDescription: A production-deployed Korean geospatial platform that turns public address, parcel, zoning, and land-price data into structured evidence for applications and AI agents.
highlights: Built deterministic ingestion and validation for a documented full-load snapshot of approximately 39.7M parcels and 222M parcel land-use designation records, with source and dataset-version metadata in primary serving tables.
Exposed 15 REST routes and seven MCP tools over stdio or HTTP. The API returns government determinations verbatim and computes no derived scores.
Designed request IDs, API-key access, IP and per-key rate limits, non-blocking usage metering, and optional Sentry monitoring. Shipped the API, ETL, MCP adapter, and web UI in one non-root container.
projects.note: Dated full-load records, July–August 2026; coverage varies by dataset. The public case study includes representative code, tests, schemas, and design decisions.

projects.title: Welda RAG Prototype
projects.subtitle: Stateful workflows & retrieval observability
projects.description: An independent Korean healthcare RAG prototype combining LangGraph orchestration, vector retrieval, Neo4j knowledge, and LangSmith tracing.
projects.longDescription: An independent Korean healthcare RAG prototype combining LangGraph orchestration, vector retrieval, Neo4j knowledge, and LangSmith tracing.
highlights: Built explicit shared state, conditional intent routing, five lifecycle stages, and separate emergency and medical-referral paths in LangGraph.
Combined vector retrieval and graph context with web-search fallback, source attribution, and streamed responses; configured LangSmith run tracing.
Built a separate local evaluation harness comparing BGE-M3 and KURE-v1 on 15 labeled Korean queries using retrieval quality and latency metrics.
projects.note: CLI prototype, May 2026. Evaluation used a small local dataset; this is not a clinically validated service.

projects.title: InterviewMate
projects.subtitle: Real-time speech & retrieval for interview practice
projects.description: An interview preparation and mock-session app. I am the sole engineer: architecture, deployment, and production debugging.
projects.longDescription: An interview preparation and mock-session app. Spoken practice questions are transcribed in real time and answered with suggestions grounded in the user's own prepared context. I am the sole engineer: architecture, deployment, and production debugging.
highlights: Built the streaming path: browser audio over WebSocket, FFmpeg, Deepgram streaming STT, user-scoped Qdrant retrieval (up to three parallel sub-queries, 5 s timeout each), and Claude streaming.
Fixed a production bug where unrelated equal-length strings scored 0.95 similarity and returned the wrong prepared answer; raised the direct-return threshold from 0.70 to 0.85.
Turned an unexplained production answer into controlled prompt studies and, later, an open-weight replication with activation-oracle read-outs.
projects.note: Engineering and research links focus on the implementation and reproducible experiments.

projects.title: Bridge-damage Detection
projects.subtitle: Class-aware evaluation under data imbalance
projects.description: An independent applied-ML study using a working dataset of 378,072 inspection images across nine damage classes. Per-class evaluation exposed gains and regressions hidden by aggregate mAP.
projects.longDescription: Compared DEIMv2-M detector experiments with a fixed validation set, examining class imbalance alongside licensing, hardware, latency, and deployment constraints. The results motivated narrower, class-aware experiments.
highlights: Kept validation fixed while varying training composition.
Used per-class AP alongside aggregate mAP to identify trade-offs.
projects.note: Independent of the geospatial serving system. Results are from limited training experiments and do not establish production readiness.

projects.title: Life Navigator
projects.subtitle: Personal AI Productivity Assistant
projects.description: NASA-inspired architecture for personal productivity optimization using Google APIs
projects.longDescription: Life Navigator applies NASA's Farm Navigators 4-layer data-driven architecture to personal productivity. Just as Farm Navigators uses satellite data (SMAP, MODIS, Landsat) for soil health analysis, Life Navigator uses personal APIs (Gmail, Calendar) for stress and schedule analysis. Features serverless Vercel functions, Redis token storage, and AI-powered life optimization recommendations.
highlights: NASA Farm Navigators architecture pattern applied to personal productivity
Real-time Gmail stress analysis and Calendar health tracking
Google OAuth 2.0 with secure token handling
Vercel Edge Functions for global performance
Upstash Redis for OAuth token persistence
AI-powered personalized recommendations
